title: Node cannot configure its LinkLayer short destination address
description: Correctness review found LinkLayer now correctly rejects SHORT frames unless local_short_addr is configured, but NodeConfig has no local_short_addr field and Node.__post_init__ never passes one. Every Node instance therefore returns NOT_FOR_US for all authenticated short-addressed frames, even though short addressing is normative and spec/09-packets-timing.md §13.1 uses a short-addressed border router example. Add a validated Node configuration/plumbing path for the assigned non-reserved short address (including DAD lifecycle semantics as applicable) and integration tests proving matching short frames are accepted while other short addresses are rejected.
notes: Implemented NodeConfig.local_short_addr post-DAD plumbing and exact matching/nonmatching authenticated SHORT frame tests; validation delegated to LinkLayer's non-reserved exact-int contract. Awaiting 3x review; do not close yet.
